newsitem.title: USA: Mahoney joins PaineWebber muni group.
newsitem.headline: Mahoney joins PaineWebber muni group.

text.p: Francis K. Mahoney has joined PaineWebber Inc, a unit of PaineWebber Group Inc, as first vice president and investment banker in its Municipal Securities Group, the firm said Tuesday.
Mahoney will join the New York Finance Group, working closely with PaineWebber managing director Walter Kicinski, and focusing on major issuers in New York.

"The addition of Frank Mahoney enhances the New York team and our overall commitment to public finance," said Terry Atkinson, managing director and manager of PaineWebber's Municipal Securities Group.
Mahoney previously was executive vice president of Empire State Development Corp.
Before that, he was lead staff member for New York Gov. George Pataki's transition team, focusing on economic development, public authorities, and housing and community development.
Mahoney is also a former vice president in the public finance department of CS First Boston.
